Bento for macOS 0.2.14
What’s new
- Turn Bento off and on without rebuilding your edited slots, display assignments, or floating-window choices. - Restore overflow windows to the Dock when resuming the same layout. - Drag floating windows into a slot to split it without ejecting another window, using Bento’s shared placement rules. - Move windows onto an empty display through the same validated drop calculation. - Clamp divider moves to newly discovered app size limits within the existing split tree, with one bounded correction. - Show clear swap, hold-to-split, and directional split feedback; ignore stationary clicks on drifted windows. - Restore newly admitted windows to their pre-drag positions when Bento is turned off.
